name: install_apk
description: Install an Android APK file onto the connected mobile device and verify installation success.

apk_path.description: Local file path or URL to the .apk file

reinstall.description: Whether to overwrite an existing installation (-r flag)

name: launch_app
description: Launch an installed Android application by its package name and optional activity.

clear_state.description: Clear app data before launching for a clean test run

name: inspect_ui_state
description: Dump the active screen UI hierarchy to check visible buttons, text fields, and verify the screen rendered properly.

expected_text.description: Optional text or label to verify on the current screen

name: check_app_logs
description: Read device logcat output for a package to detect crashes, exceptions, or ANR errors.

package_name.description: Android package identifier to filter logs

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to inspect (default 100)

name: capture_screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the current mobile screen to visually verify the app state.

save_path.description: File path to save the captured PNG screenshot

name: get_weather
description: Get current weather conditions and temperature for a given city.

name: set_smart_light
description: Control smart home lights in a specific room.
